'''Jon VanDerMeer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 2 FL from San Antonio, Tx. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

VanDerMeer made the [[1998 Decipher World Championship]] final twelve. The packet lists the name as "Jon VanderMeer." VanDerMeer qualified through Dantooine Houston from San Antonio, Texas. He refused to play Operatives decks on Days 1 and 2 of that Worlds.<ref name="list-65787">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/65787.html? swccg-discussion message #65787], tsquare9 (23 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110003747/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/65787.html? Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pkt">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf 1998 World Championship packet], Decipher / Kendrick Summers (20 November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195330/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/1998-World-Championship.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="trando">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/wf00p2.htm History of the World Finals], [[Trandosite]].</ref>
